clock_basis: Checkpoint UTC timestamp; not the exact evidence publication time

human_authorization.authorized_scope: Create unapproved immutable version 1.2 from version 1.1 incorporating the answers to A-01 through A-09 and the subsequent ticket closure/cancellation, real email, cancelled-ticket retention, and tenant-deletion reversal clarifications.

knowledge_approval: Separate processing status from approval state.
Tenant Admin approves or rejects exact document versions.
Only the current approved version is retrievable; update/reprocessing invalidates stale approval/index entries.
rbac_and_privileged_controls: Centralized default-deny role/resource/action permissions, tenant/team scope, and no custom roles or tenant overrides.
Tenant Admin cannot assign Platform Admin; Agents cannot assign/reassign tickets; Managers remain team-scoped.
Privileged Platform Admin changes require a second independent approver; no self-approval or self-elevation.
support_teams: Tenant Admin owns tenant team lifecycle and membership, assigns one primary Manager per team, and Agents belong to one primary team.
Managers may manage multiple assigned teams, read team membership, and cannot change membership.
ticket_workflow: Defined New, Open, In Progress, Pending Customer, Resolved, Closed, and Cancelled states and authorized transitions.
Closure is only from Resolved; reopening requires a reason; cancellation is terminal, requires a reason and notes, and is not deletion.
Ticket assignment separates team and agent; managers and tenant administrators have distinct routing scopes.
customer_lookup: Added exact customer and related-ticket allowlists, default email masking, and exclusions for sensitive fields/notes/attachments.
Enforced role, tenant, team, and ticket-level lookup restrictions, including restricted Platform Admin business-data access.
retention_and_tenant_lifecycle: Added proposed configurable retention for business data, activity, feedback, AI results, audit, documents, conversations, evaluations, and backups.
Added immediate tenant deactivation controls, 30-day deletion grace, independent deletion approval, and two-admin reversal approval before purge.
async_jobs_and_timeouts: Added persisted job states, HTTP 202/Job ID submissions, authorized status/results, separate configurable bounded timeouts, and safe retries.
account_recovery_and_email: Added ASP.NET Core Identity password/reset rules, generic responses, configurable 12-character/30-minute/5-failure/15-minute defaults, and role-scoped recovery.
Included a real transactional email provider in first-release scope; provider selection remains deferred to implementation.
evaluation_governance: Kept all proposed AI evaluation percentages non-gating even after Requirement Approval unless separately authorized.
Defined retrieval, claim-level grounding, citation correctness and coverage, abstention, structured-output failure-rate, and prompt-injection measurements.
